prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1386; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative: On arrival at the intersection in Pearland, Texas, I observed two passenger vehicles with visible damage consistent with a side impact. Driver 1 was operating a sedan northbound and stated that the signal had been green for their direction. Driver 2 was operating an SUV westbound and stated that they had entered the intersection on a yellow light. Damage to the driver side of the sedan and the passenger side of the SUV was consistent with the reported collision path. A single Passenger was seated in the sedan and was not injured. Driver 1 reported neck pain and stiffness immediately after the impact and was evaluated at the scene by EMS, who noted tenderness in the cervical region without visible bleeding. Driver 1 declined transport at that time. Both vehicles were drivable and were moved to the curb. Traffic signal timing was reviewed and no malfunction was observed. Citations were not issued at the scene pending further review of witness statements.
